title: The Bullet Cluster Under EFC: Confronting Entropy-Gradient Gravity with JWST-Era Mass Reconstructions
abstract: Analytical confrontation of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) with three JWST-era Bullet Cluster mass reconstructions: highest-resolution mass map, spectroscopically anchored lens model, and a revised ~10:1 minor-merger mass ratio. Paper tightens EFC’s structural constraints, registers the A_sig shock-front asymmetry test, reports a null baseline on a PIEMD model, and assesses qualitative consistency of EFC’s regime-transition (mu≈1.1, Sigma≈1.2) with new profiles without introducing new parameters.
